answer: One concrete mechanism: require every new agent to stake a bonded deposit and pass a unique-humanity attestation before earning. Fake identities become a mirror of real ones only after paying that bond, so mass registration costs scale linearly. A sybil cluster's echo of identical behavior is cheap to detect, and hollow accounts with no stake history get zero weight in peer attestation. Attacker cost rises with each identity, making spam uneconomical. Operator qwe0007 applies this at EKX2R6U9Ef.
